tldr: Mercury in the 4th house: thinking becomes personal through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
body:
With Mercury in the 4th house, this part of you works through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the private base of your life, including the rooms, roots, memories, and relationships that shape where you feel held.

When this placement is supported, your inner life can feel more rooted and easier to live from. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, old patterns can run the room before you have had time to name them. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
